cards.power: Documents domestic decay with awe, dread, and a clipboard held too close to the chest.
cards.lore: The jokes are just a shield to let the truth slip in behind them.
cards.gradeReason: The clipboard is a weapon. Chaos meets its documentarian. G1 masterpiece.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor comic. Subject: Yellow rabbit curator surveying paper avalanche with clipboard. Mood: Aghast authority.

cards.power: Rejects the concept of putting things back so completely that the room becomes the work.
cards.lore: Chaos isn't an accident; it's a fractal, self-organizing lifestyle choice.
cards.gradeReason: Chaos as philosophy, raccoon as queen. The room IS the work. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor. Subject: Raccoon queen enthroned in glorious mess, crown askew. Mood: Regal chaos.

cards.power: Reframes a flatmate's biohazardous neglect into a self-important, high-art retrospective.
cards.lore: Put a forensic marker on a dirty plate, and it stops being gross and starts being avant-garde.
cards.gradeReason: Reframes biohazard as art. The forensic marker line? Instant classic. Canonized.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor comic. Subject: Pelican curator on pedestal addressing garbage heap. Mood: Pompous grandeur.

cards.power: Combines textiles, ceramics, snack packaging, and slow, patient rotting into a living installation.
cards.lore: The art doesn't just sit there—it touches you back.
cards.gradeReason: It touches you back. Five words that end the argument. G1 always.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Botanical horror. Subject: Sloth cocooned in caution tape amid mushrooms and textiles. Mood: Lush decomposition.

cards.power: RECLASSIFIES ALL DESIGNATED WORKSTATIONS INTO PERMANENT, LOAD-BEARING STORAGE.
cards.lore: A FLAT SURFACE IS JUST A CHALLENGE WAITING TO BE BURIED UNDER FOUR IDENTIFIED STRATA.
cards.gradeReason: A flat surface is a challenge. Mythologizing the buried desk: brilliant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cross-section diagram. Subject: Beaver buried beneath archaeological layers of books and papers. Mood: Academic despair.

cards.power: INTRODUCES EXPOSED CUTLERY TO THEORETICAL SLEEPING SPACES.
cards.lore: VIEWER DISCRETION IS MANDATORY WHEN THE BLANKETS HAVE SHARP EDGES.
cards.gradeReason: Funny concept, passive performance. Sleeper knows; guest doesn't. Slightly descriptor-mode.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Museum label horror. Subject: Porcupine bristling with forks on white background. Mood: Clinical hazard.

cards.power: STACKS EMPTY CUPS UNTIL THEY BECOME STRUCTURALLY INTEGRAL TO THE ROOM'S ARCHITECTURE.
cards.lore: REMOVE THE BOTTOM CUP, AND THE ENTIRE ECOSYSTEM COLLAPSES.
cards.gradeReason: The bottom cup ecosystem collapse lore is structural comedy genius.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Engineering drama. Subject: Camel balancing impossible tower of mugs on back. Mood: Precarious triumph.

cards.power: LAYERS UNWASHED CLOTHING INTO HISTORICAL SEDIMENT DATING BACK AN ESTIMATED SIX WEEKS.
cards.lore: YOU CAN CARBON-DATE THE MOOD BY THE DEPTH OF THE SWEATPANTS.
cards.gradeReason: Carbon-date by sweatpants depth. Geological clothing archaeology. Immediately wearable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sediment diagram. Subject: Octopus submerged in clothing strata with geological depth chart. Mood: Scientific despair.

cards.power: Habitats exclusively inside the sink basin, flirting dangerously with the plumbing.
cards.lore: Oral care hits different when it shares real estate with a surface hygiene of 0/10.
cards.gradeReason: Solid gross-out concept. 'Habitats' as a verb needs fixing. Describe gap.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor editorial. Subject: Flamingo standing in sink drain flirting with toothbrush. Mood: Oblivious hygiene.

cards.power: Presides over the toilet with unresolved, mathematical authority.
cards.lore: No one knows what was being calculated, but the math is definitely wrong.
cards.gradeReason: Math is definitely wrong. Owl presiding over toilet. Zero notes. Instant classic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor. Subject: Crowned owl on toilet lid with whiteboard of wrong equations. Mood: Mathematical authority.

cards.power: Holds ambiguous liquids of unknown age, commanding a wide berth.
cards.lore: You don't want to know what it held, but your survival instincts demand it.
cards.gradeReason: Good smell-fear hook. Power is too passive. Describes rather than invites.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Crime scene. Subject: Skunk beside murky mystery glass container with emanating fumes. Mood: Biologically threatening.

cards.power: Stages high-fashion despair in the dampest, least appropriate corner of the house.

cards.gradeReason: High-fashion despair in the dampest corner. Geneva called. First-ballot G1.

cards.power: Reclassifies communal seating into a personal closet by popular vote of one.

cards.gradeReason: Popular vote of one. The laundry river vector is perfect. Instantly performable.

cards.power: Stacks up to five days of plates on a single, groaning bamboo tray.

cards.gradeReason: Vertical engineering is the winning reframe. Goat-on-plates image seals it.

cards.power: Petrifies organic matter until it becomes part of the permanent geological record.

cards.power: Crushes handmade paper affections into the dusty floorboards.

cards.power: Defends every biohazard as a misunderstood, avant-garde masterpiece.
cards.lore: The way she layers laundry like sediment?? Tate Modern is shaking.
cards.gradeReason: Tate Modern is shaking. Username: avantgarbage. She DEFENDS. Instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Social media tableau. Subject: Laughing hyena holding phone, defending mess with hearts. Mood: Evangelical delight.

cards.power: Summons the judgment of the 1950s to diagnose your lack of character.

cards.gradeReason: Brain competes with trash. Good lore. Educational framing over invitation.

verdict: MoMM is the tightest concept-to-execution ratio in the corpus: domestic chaos reframed as high art, sustained across 15 pages without losing the bit once. The social media jury page (Stan/Boomer/Investigator/Repulsed) is a standalone viral object. Only soft spots are the prescriptive science pages (G2 drift) and the three developer-facing meta cards at the end (Notebook Ingestion, 600px Limit) that break the satirical spell for non-technical audiences. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: For everyone who's ever pointed at a dirty plate and called it a daring feat of vertical engineering. MoMM is a card deck for the aesthetic defenders of domestic chaos—and everyone who has to live with them.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — Yellow caution tape border, FrizzleBob in paper avalanche, raccoon queen on mess-throne, pelican on pedestal, sloth in mushroom caution-tape tangle. Four distinct scenes, all punching.
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'Welcome to the Museum of Modern Mess, where admission is free but the exit costs your sanity.' One of the best cover headlines in the corpus.
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Museum-of-chaos aesthetic locks in immediately. The KayfaBINGO margin note seals it.
coverQA.coverOriginality: 5 — MoMM as institutional satire is a novel frame for this universe. Nothing like it in the corpus.
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — Strong, but the four-card cover layout requires a second look to parse. Single hero image would hit harder on scroll.
coverQA.coverNote: Best cover headline in the corpus, possibly the best single cover concept. The four-card layout is dense but earns it because every card is G1. The raccoon queen and the CAUTION tape framing do the viral work.

notes: Pages 2–3 (cards 5–12) have ALL-CAPS baked-in power/lore text — likely a decorative font choice rather than error, but reduces readability vs. mixed-case pages. Cards 57–59 (final meta page) are clearly developer/creator-facing and may confuse general audience. The deck has an unusually coherent internal arc: characters → room taxonomy → social reactions → science → solutions → smells → AI futures → game mechanics → press → tools → new terms → handover → meta. A narrative spine through 60 cards is rare. The 'KayfaBINGO/KayfaBOGGLE/KayfaBONGO' margin callouts escalate delightfully across the deck.

urgent: Fix 'habitats exclusively inside the sink basin' — 'habitats' is not a verb. Rephrase power for The Drain Toothbrush.

quickWins: Page 5 (Stan/Boomer/Investigator/Repulsed) is a standalone viral extract — crop and post individually.
The Fossilized Tomato + Olfactory Memory pair as a 2-card deathbed sequence — social-ready.
